Via.description: How Discord carries commands to herald.

oneOf.description:
Discord posts each interaction to herald's endpoint, signed with the
application's key: served by `herald server` and by a serverless
driver.

herald holds a connection to Discord's gateway and takes each
interaction from it: served by `herald server`, with no public
endpoint.

Via2.description: How the homeserver carries commands to herald.

oneOf.description:
The homeserver pushes each room event to herald as an application
service, with the registration `herald matrix registration` writes:
served by `herald server` and by a serverless driver.

herald syncs as the bot account and reads each message in the rooms
it has joined: served by `herald server`, with no public endpoint and
nothing for the homeserver's administrator to install.

token, and takes each one from it: served by `herald server`, with no
public endpoint.
